howto.name: Upload an .rtf file
howto.text: Drop a Rich Text Format file (Word, WordPad, TextEdit, Pages all save in RTF).

howto.name: PrivaTools renders to PDF
howto.text: Bold, italic, underline, paragraph styles, lists, tables, and embedded images transfer faithfully.

howto.name: Download the PDF
howto.text: Click Convert. Open in any PDF viewer.

faq.q: What about RTF features like fields?
faq.a: Calculated fields (page numbers, dates) render as their current values. Form fields aren't converted to PDF form fields — use Form Creator for that.
Fonts referenced in the RTF are matched to server-installed fonts. Missing fonts fall back to a close visual equivalent.

faq.q: How does this differ from DOCX-to-PDF?
faq.a: RTF is an older Microsoft format. DOCX is a newer ZIP-based format. Both convert similarly but DOCX preserves more layout fidelity.
